note: Alberta Parks campground in Oldman Dam Provincial Recreation Area, 13 km north of Pincher Creek on Hwy 785, by the Oldman River under cottonwoods. Showers and the sani-dump are at Castleview Campground on the north side of the river. Campers are encouraged to bring a supply of drinking water. --Claude
summary: Read the Alberta Parks page and shop: 78 sites (51 unserviced C$28, 27 power C$36), power is 15 A (was 30, derived), count 78 (was 82), 28-78 ft; vault toilets, taps; showers and dump are at Castleview; season May 15 - Sep 30 (was an approximate May-Oct). Stored 'pond' questioned: the river is the closer water for the north-arc sites; riverfront recommended. Phone 403-627-1165.
flags: WATERFRONT (stored pond; recommend riverfront with a caveat; human decides): the shop tags 'Near Water' on sites A-16, A-19, A-20, A-22, A-24, A-26, A-27, A-29 and B-30, B-31, B-34, B-36, B-38, B-40, B-41, B-45, B-47, B-49 - the outer (river-side) rows of the west loop and the north arc on the tear-sheet campground map; none of the sites near the pond (50-82) is tagged. On imagery the north-arc pads (sites ~38-49) sit ~20-40 m from the Oldman River's main channel across open grass with scattered cottonwoods, and B-40's shop photos show the river at the foot of the bluffs past the picnic table. The west-loop rows (A-16..29) face a gravel/sand bar and are ~80-150 m from the water. The stored evidence ('Oldman River is set back >200m across braided floodplain') described only the west end. The pond: ~130 x 100 m of water (~1 ha, under 5 acres, so 'pond' is the right word for it) sunk in a dugout with a bare 10 m bank; pads on the loop road south of it are ~15-30 m from its edge, so pond is defensible, but the river is the better-earned value. Suggested caveat: 'The north-arc sites (about 30-49) are on the river; the rest are set back.'

HOOKUPS: stored electric 30 (derived from note prose) replaced with 15 - the table gives '15' and the page warns 'Do not use adapters to draw power from a 15 amp for an RV with a 30 amp plug'. Sites count 82 (derived) -> 78 (51 + 27).

FACILITIES: the amenity list includes 'Sewage Disposal' but the page says the station (and the showers) are in Castleview Campground across the river, so showers and dump were left unset and said in the note.
PHONE (stored empty): 'Information: 403-627-1165'. No 'Facility Operator' line. Recommend 403-627-1165. Website URLs both answered 200 and are this campground.
SENIORS LINE: present - 'This campground qualifies for the camping fee discount for Alberta seniors.' 90-day line matches the provincial:AB row. Bookings open February 14.
SHOP: 'Closed through Thu May 06 2027' (park-level for parkId 330307, which also holds Castleview; Cottonwood's own season starts May 15).
ADVISORY: 'Bear Closure - Castle River Day Use' (October 5, 2026 - until further notice) is another area of the PRA, not this campground.
PIN (49.55783,-113.87440): at the campground entrance on Hwy 785, ~120-150 m south-east of the loops (the page's directions point is 49.559623,-113.872228). Within tolerance.
